svg.title: E2 / Flat-printed contact panels
svg.desc: Concept investigation only, not to scale or evaluated CAD. Normal black TPU, no thickness cap. Blue is facing material, green is compliant structure, brown is solid corner or perimeter material. Process and assembly views show proposals, not verified toolpaths.

g.text: E2 / Flat-printed contact panels
Change which surface touches the bed, and when the core is made.
SVG PROPOSAL • 21 Oct 2026 • black TPU • thickness free • no new model or slice
Make the visible face first, flat against the build surface
Object-facing side against the build surface
Z ↑
1 Print a continuous facing plate.
2 Grow open core features on its back.
3 Fit tiles into a separate outer carrier.
No core roof is closed during printing.
Carrier provides the assembled outer skin.
Plate finish and cooling still matter.
Turn the finished tiles upright and capture their edges
Four wall tiles + floor + lid face.
Carrier and lid backing add two parts.
Solid rails close and capture corners.
No glue or folded hinge assumed.
What this buys — and what it does not establish
Example budget: 1.6 facing + 2.0 open core + 0.8 carrier ≈ 4.4 mm.
Strong change: visible surface is bed-supported and completed before the core starts.
Trade-off: about eight parts, corner joints, edge capture and build-surface texture.
Later core cooling may still distort a tile. Gloss and damping are not guaranteed.
Solid corners + gradual transition required. Dimensions are discussion examples; Classic qualification comes later.
